name: SQL → msg.topic
func:
// ⚠️ SQL 写在 function 里，不配置在 mysql 节点的 query 属性中
// 原因: mysql 节点的 query 在导出 flow 时会丢失！

msg.topic = `
SELECT d.id AS device_id, d.device_name, d.device_code,
       d.plc_brand, d.plc_series, d.com_type,
       d.plc_ip, d.plc_port, d.mc_frame,
       d.station_no, d.network_no,
       d.scan_interval_ms, d.comm_timeout_ms,
       d.retry_count, d.trigger_kind,
       t.id AS tag_id, t.tag_name,
       t.register_type, t.register_address,
       t.data_type, t.unit
FROM plc_device d
JOIN plc_tag t ON d.id = t.device_id
WHERE d.status = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0'
  AND t.status = '0' AND t.del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY d.id, t.sort_order, t.id
`;
return msg;
